pages.title: About AeroIE
pages.text: AeroIE, short for Aeronautics: InterStellar Expansion, expands Aeronautics with integrated control, propulsion, weapons, and other systems. Its goal is to provide a straightforward platform for interstellar travel and high-performance vehicles. Centered on the Control Seat, it offers easier data transfer and unified ship control than ordinary redstone systems.$(br2)AeroIE avoids obscure configuration screens and difficult component-by-component operation. It aims to make integrated vehicle control understandable and convenient for every player.

pages.title: Fun Facts
pages.text: 1. Before Aeronautics was released, AeroIE was developed as a Valkyrien Skies addon, as its distinctive mod ID still suggests. Before moving to Aeronautics, it already had a functional, though incomplete, build for Valkyrien Skies 2.4.$(br2)Development passed through several migrations: Valkyrien Skies 2.3 → Create 6.0 → Valkyrien Skies 2.4 → Aeronautics.$(br2)2. AeroIE is open source under the GPL-3.0 license. Corrections to KODU16's cobblestone-tier code are always welcome.
